name: Theme Creator
description: Design your own Kanvaz color theme with live preview, save it as a named preset, and reset to Kanvaz's defaults anytime.
author: Northbyte Studios

name: MCP Bridge
description: Lets Claude Desktop, Claude Code, or any other MCP-compatible AI tool read and edit your active board over a local-only connection. Off by default — every change lands in undo history like a manual edit.
author: Northbyte Studios

name: Template Maker & Manager
description: Save any board as a reusable template, manage your own collection, and browse/install templates other people made — all local, no in-app payments or marketplace.
author: Northbyte Studios
